It then held a new hearing for 240 Summer Street (a contractor's yard). It granted two waivers, closed the hearing, and approved the site plan and stormwater permit with conditions. It also gave a recommendation on a Chapter 61B right of first refusal at 20 Kilburn Street, discussed ARPA project ideas, heard committee reports, and approved the June 24 minutes.
